brokerage.title: Brokerage
brokerage.subtitle: Your brokerage's identity, disclosures and members.

none.title: You haven't declared a brokerage
none.body: You'll declare your brokerage when you complete your profile. Until then you can still draft and prepare listings on your own.

pending.title: Waiting for {brokerage} to approve you
pending.body: A broker admin of {brokerage} needs to approve your membership. Until then, nothing about the brokerage is shared with you, and your listings stay private to you.

ended.body: You no longer have access to this brokerage. You can still prepare listings on your own, and you can declare a brokerage again from your profile.

banner.title: Your membership at {brokerage} is pending approval
banner.body: You can draft listings, run photo analysis, and generate and check content now. Approving marketing and submitting to the MLS unlock once a broker admin approves you, because both carry the brokerage's name and license.

settings.title: Brokerage settings
settings.readOnlyNote: Only a broker admin can change these settings.
settings.name: Brokerage name
settings.requiredDisclaimersHint: One per line. These appear on marketing that names the brokerage.
settings.targetMlsIdHint: For example CRMLS. Leave empty if you don't submit to an MLS.
settings.budgetHint: AI work for a listing stops at this limit, and the agent can continue by hand.

members.title: Members
members.pendingEmpty: No one is waiting for approval.

index.title: Listings
index.subtitle: Drafts you can pick up where you left off.
index.empty: You have no listings yet. Start one to upload photos and enter the basics.
index.archiveConfirm: Archive {address}? It leaves your listings, and its history is kept.

wizard.title: New listing
wizard.subtitle: Enter the basics, add photos, and come back any time — everything saves as you go.
wizard.archived: This listing is archived. It's kept with its history but can no longer be changed.

basics.title: Basic details
basics.agentNotesHint: Private to you. Never copied into public remarks.

save.failed: Couldn't save your last change. It's still here, and saving resumes when you edit again.
save.invalid: Fix the highlighted field and it will save.
save.conflictBody: Another tab or device saved a newer version. Load it to continue; edits made here since then will be replaced.

required.title: Required before publishing
required.body: No public-record source is connected, so enter these yourself. They are never filled in by AI.

photos.title: Photos
photos.body: Add 1 to 100 photos. Originals are kept exactly as uploaded; nothing is generated or retouched.
photos.formats: JPEG, PNG, HEIC or WebP, up to 50 MB each.
photos.overLimit: You chose {chosen} photos, but this listing has room for {room} more. Nothing was uploaded; choose fewer.
photos.full: This listing has 100 photos, the most allowed.

rejected.too_large: {file} was not accepted: it is larger than 50 MB.
rejected.unsupported_format: {file} was not accepted: it isn't a JPEG, PNG, HEIC or WebP photo.
rejected.too_many_pixels: {file} was not accepted: its dimensions are too large to process.
rejected.unreadable: {file} was not accepted: it looks damaged or only partly saved.
rejected.duplicate: {file} was not added: it is identical to a photo already on this listing.
rejected.storage_failed: {file} couldn't be stored just now. Add it again.
rejected.unknown: {file} couldn't be uploaded. Add it again.

progress.title: Before you publish
progress.aiNote: Photo analysis and content drafting come next. Every AI result stays a draft until you approve it.

analysis.title: Photo analysis
analysis.body: Analysis suggests a room type, visible features, quality and content flags, a caption, a cover and an order for each photo. Every result is a suggestion you can change.
analysis.retryHint: Running analysis again only analyzes the photos that failed.

manual.noModel: Photo analysis isn't available right now. Every step can be done by hand below.
manual.budget: This listing's AI budget is used up. Finish the remaining photos by hand below.
manual.noPhotos: Add at least one photo before starting analysis.

photoState.failed: Couldn't analyze — set it by hand or analyze again

errors.validation: That change wasn't accepted. Check the highlighted field.
errors.forbidden: You can't change this listing's photos.
errors.notFound: This photo isn't available any more. Reload the page.
errors.pairedOriginal: This photo is shown beside an altered photo. Withdraw that declaration first.
errors.unexpected: Something went wrong. Please try again.

content.title: Listing content
content.body: Drafted from your listing's facts, or written by you. Sentences that rest on a fact you haven't confirmed are highlighted, and the listing can't be published until you confirm the fact or remove the sentence.
content.toneHint: Used the next time content is generated. Your choice is recorded with each draft.
content.generateFailed: This content couldn't be generated. Write it yourself, or try again.
content.empty: Nothing here yet. Generate it, or write it yourself.
content.claimNote: rests on a fact you haven't confirmed: {facts}
content.claimsSummary: {count} highlighted sentence(s) rest on facts you haven't confirmed. Confirm them in the listing's details, or edit the sentences out.
content.approvedNote: Approved. Editing it withdraws the approval and returns the listing to review.
content.conflict: This content was changed somewhere else since you opened it.

manual.noModel: Generating content isn't available right now. Write it yourself below.
manual.profileIncomplete: This listing's MLS doesn't have verified character limits yet, so nothing can be generated to them. Write it yourself below.
manual.budget: This listing's AI budget is used up. Write the content yourself below.
manual.running: This listing is already being analyzed. Generate content once that finishes.

errors.validation: That wasn't accepted. Check the text and try again.
errors.overLimit: The MLS allows at most {limit} characters here.
errors.superseded: A newer version of this content exists. Reload the page to edit it.
errors.exists: This content already exists. Reload the page to edit it.
errors.forbidden: You can't change this listing's content.
errors.notFound: This content isn't available any more. Reload the page.
errors.unexpected: Something went wrong. Please try again.

compliance.title: Compliance review
compliance.body: Checks the listing's copy and photos against Fair Housing rules, risky claims, the MLS's rules and the photo-disclosure requirements. Blocking findings must be fixed before the listing can be approved; warnings can be acknowledged with a reason.
compliance.allClear: Nothing open. Every finding has been fixed or acknowledged.
compliance.blockingNote: Blocking findings can't be dismissed. Change the content so the check no longer finds it.

acknowledge.title: Acknowledge a warning
acknowledge.body: Say why this warning doesn't need a change. Your reason is kept in the audit trail with your name and the time.

errors.running: This listing is already being checked or analyzed. Try again when that finishes.
errors.changed: This content changed since the check ran. Check compliance again.
errors.noFix: This finding has no wording to apply. Edit the content yourself.
errors.reasonTooShort: Give a reason of at least 10 characters.
errors.forbidden: You can't change this listing's compliance review.
errors.notFound: This finding isn't available any more. Reload the page.
errors.unexpected: Something went wrong. Please try again.

grid.label: Listing photos
grid.caption: Caption for photo {n}
grid.removeConfirm: Remove photo {n} from this listing? The original file is kept on record.
grid.applySuggestions: Apply the suggested order and cover

reasons.rule:cover:exterior_front: A clear view of the front makes the best first impression.
reasons.rule:cover:model_recommended: The clearest photo the analysis recommended as a cover.
reasons.rule:cover:first_clean: The first photo without an issue to resolve.
reasons.order: Placed for a walk through the house: {room}.

altered.title: Declare an alteration
altered.body: California requires an edited photo to be labeled and shown beside its unaltered original. This records what you did elsewhere — this system never edits photos.
altered.label: Disclosure label
altered.noLabels: No disclosure label is approved for this listing's MLS yet, so an alteration can't be declared. Use the unaltered photo instead.
altered.noOriginal: Upload the unaltered original first; it is shown beside the altered photo.

facts.title: Listing facts
facts.body: Every fact on the listing and where it came from. Facts detected by AI stay unconfirmed until you confirm them, and content resting on them can't be approved until then.

approval.title: Approval
approval.body: Approve each output for the MLS once you have reviewed it. Approval records you, the time, and exactly what you approved. Editing anything afterwards withdraws the approval.
approval.approveListing: Approve the listing for the MLS
approval.changed: This changed since you loaded the page. It has been refreshed — review it again, then approve.

blockers.blocking_finding_open: A blocking compliance finding is still open.
blockers.unconfirmed_ai_fact: It rests on a fact you haven't confirmed.
blockers.membership_not_approved: Your brokerage membership isn't approved yet.
blockers.rule_profile_incomplete: The MLS's rules aren't verified yet, so nothing can be approved against them.
blockers.content_changed_since_review: It changed since you reviewed it.
blockers.compliance_not_run: It hasn't been checked for compliance since it last changed. Run the check.
blockers.content_not_approved: Approve the content it publishes first.
blockers.analysis_in_progress: Analysis or generation is still running.
